retrievalProfile.description: A highly symmetrical composition featuring a central human figure flanked by metallic, statuesque secondary figures within a circular architectural frame.
triggerTerms: central figure with mirrored side figures
excludeWhen: organic or hand-drawn styles are preferred

recipe.visualDefinition: A central male figure sits in a prayer-like pose, anchored by a large circular architectural ring. He is flanked by two mirrored, silver-metallic female figures in dynamic, kneeling poses. The background is a clean, high-key white with intricate filigree and geometric borders.
coreVisualRelationships: Central figure as the primary focal point
Mirrored metallic figures creating a symmetrical frame
Circular architectural element enclosing the subject
High-contrast red footwear against a neutral metallic palette
coreInvariants: High-key white background with subtle grey shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure occupies the middle third vertically and horizontally; secondary figures are scaled to match his height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the large geometric title at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top title, moves down to the central face, follows the curves of the side statues, and ends at the red shoes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space around the central cluster emphasizes the complexity of the central arrangement.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Metallic Silver and Gold (statues and architectural elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value, punctuated by a single high-saturation accent.

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight in the main title
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the main title features a diagonal crossbar that aligns with the 'S' and 'G' angles.

composition.relationshipToImage: layered over the top of the frame

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, custom geometric display font paired with a clean, wide-tracked secondary sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, geometric structure of the secondary text.
Provides the necessary technical and wide aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key white scene with a central man in a grey sweatshirt and patterned pants sitting in a prayer pose. Surround him with two mirrored silver-metallic statues of kneeling women and a large circular stone ring. Add delicate filigree in the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, gold-textured geometric block font at the top center. Add secondary wide-tracked sans-serif text below the main title and at the bottom center.

verificationChecks: Are the side figures rendered with a metallic silver texture?
Is the red footwear the only high-saturation element?

adjustableVariables: Texture of the statues (e.g., marble instead of silver)
Accent color (e.g., blue instead of red)
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the central subject
Exact wording of the original text

mustAchieve: Sharp, realistic textures on metallic surfaces

postGenerationChecks: Check for bilateral symmetry across the vertical axis.
Ensure the metallic sheen on the statues is consistent.
Verify that the typography is centered and legible.
Confirm the high-key white background is clean and free of artifacts.
recipe.reuseFormula: Symmetrical central portrait + mirrored metallic secondary figures + circular architectural frame + high-key white background + geometric display typography.
